subject: gk
question: The five-year plans in India laid down not only specific objectives to be attained in the five years of a plan, but also what was to be achieved over a period of 20 years. This long-term plan is called a __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**perspective plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, the **long-term plans **that delineate specific objectives to be achieved over five years and 20 years are referred to as** perspective plans.**
 
• These plans enable adjustments in funding and projects to align with the nation's economic requirements.
 
• **Economic planning** in India entails the government's formulation of long-term strategies to develop and coordinate the economy efficiently.
 
• The first five-year plan was initiated in **1951**, marking the inception of India's planned development approach. Since then, the country has implemented twelve such plans.
 
• **The Planning Commission and the NITI Aayog** are responsible for devising, executing, and monitoring these plans.
 
• **The Prime Minister** serves as the** ex-officio chairman,** while the commission includes a nominated Deputy Chairman with the rank of a cabinet minister.
 
• The overarching objectives of the Five-Year Plans encompass achieving a high growth rate to enhance living standards, ensuring economic stability for prosperity, fostering a self-reliant economy, promoting social justice and reducing inequalities, and modernizing the economy to meet contemporary needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **From 1947 to 2017, **the Indian economy operated on the basis of planned development, which was facilitated through the implementation of **Five-Year Plans.**
 
• These plans were formulated, executed, and monitored by the Planning Commission from **1951 to 2014**, and subsequently by the** NITI Aayog** from **2015 to 2017.**
 
• The Prime Minister served as the ex-officio chairman of these commissions, while a nominated Deputy Chairman, holding the rank of a cabinet minister, assisted in their operations. Montek Singh Ahluwalia served as the** last Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission,** resigning on **May 26, 2014.**
 
• The Twelfth Plan concluded its term in March 2017.
